sloka: स राजा सह पत्न्या वै प्रणिपत्य मुहुर्मुहुः ।पुनर्वसिष्ठं प्रोवाच यदुक्तं ब्रह्मरूपिणा ।। ७.६५.३३ ॥
transliteration: sa rājā saha patnyā vai praṇipatya muhurmuhuḥ ।punarvasiṣṭhaṁ provāca yaduktaṁ brahmarūpiṇā ।। 7.65.33 ॥

translations.english: That king, along with his wife, having bowed down repeatedly, then spoke again to Vasistha, who was like Brahma in his wisdom.
